question: Is talk of difference compatible with the true fruit of cognition?
premises: Cognition itself is essentially reflective awareness.
The fruit of cognition must accord with that essential nature.
Talk of difference does not fit that fruit.
inference: Because cognition is reflective awareness, difference-based accounts are not suited to its fruit.
plain_english: That very cognition is surely of the nature of the essence of reflective awareness; therefore talk of difference is not at all well suited with regard to its fruit.
